source_text: Non enim qui in manifesto Iudaeus est, neque quae in manifesto in carne circumcisio; sed qui in abscondito Iudaeus, et circumcisio cordis in spiritu. Gentes naturaliter quae legis sunt faciunt — opus legis scriptum in cordibus. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: For not he who is a Jew outwardly, nor circumcision which is outward in the flesh; but he who is a Jew in secret, and circumcision of the heart in the Spirit. Gentiles naturally do the things of the law — the work of the law written in hearts. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[A Jew is one inwardly; circumcision is of the heart, by the Spirit >> Bible:Romans 2:28-29]]. Gentiles who [[by nature do what the law requires >> Bible:Romans 2:14]] show [[the work of the law written on their hearts >> Bible:Romans 2:15]]. Glory to Christ. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Romans.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Romans; do not copy Scheck FOTC
